gloss: parts cost; cost of replacement parts

definitions.gloss: parts cost; price of parts; cost of replacement components
definitions.explanation: The cost charged for physical parts or components, as distinct from labor charges. Commonly encountered when getting repairs done on cars, electronics, appliances, and other equipment.

examples.japanese: {部品代|ぶひんだい}は{別途|べっと}かかります。
examples.english: The parts cost is charged separately.

examples.japanese: {修理|しゅうり}の{見積|みつも}もりで{部品代|ぶひんだい}が{高|たか}くて{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the high parts cost in the repair estimate.

examples.japanese: {工賃|こうちん}は{三千円|さんぜんえん}だが、{部品代|ぶひんだい}を{含|ふく}めると{一万円|いちまんえん}を{超|こ}える。
examples.english: The labor charge is 3,000 yen, but including parts it exceeds 10,000 yen.

notes:
Composed of {部品|ぶひん} (parts, components) + {代|だい} (cost, charge). The suffix {代|だい} is one of the most common ways to express cost in Japanese, attaching to many nouns: {食事代|しょくじだい} (meal cost), {交通費|こうつうひ} (transport cost), {電気代|でんきだい} (electricity bill).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}と{工賃|こうちん}: parts cost and labor charge
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}{込|こ}み: parts included (in the price)
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}が{高|たか}い: parts are expensive
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}{別途|べっと}: parts charged separately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {工賃|こうちん}: labor charge — the cost of the work itself
- {修理代|しゅうりだい}: repair cost — the total cost of a repair
- {材料費|ざいりょうひ}: material cost — broader term covering raw materials
